壱Chapter 01 · The Jutsu Dojo · 術の道場

Weave the signs. Break the training ground.

Six hand signs, five jutsu. Weave three signs to fire Chidori, a wind blade or a Kamehameha at the training posts, go Super Saiyan for double damage, then shout Arise and watch every broken post climb back as a shadow soldier. This is the kind of motion I put into sites people remember.

  • Canvas and CSS effects that hold 60 fps on a phone
  • Click, scroll and hover moments cut like an anime fight
  • Sound effects made in the browser, no heavy files
  • Calm fallbacks for people who turn motion off

Letter your own page. Save it as a picture.

Three panels, the whole cast and a box of sound effects. Put a heroine in each panel, write what she says, stamp a DOOON or a ZAAA, then save the page as a PNG. It is a real little web app, the kind I build for creators and shops.

  • Tap and type editing that works on a phone
  • PNG export in the browser, no server needed
  • Your page is saved while you work
  • Made for comics, memes, cards and merch mock-ups

How a project goes

From the first message to the months after launch. Drag the paper, or use the seals below.

相談 Day 0

The talk

You tell me what the business needs, in a call or a chat. I ask the boring questions early: who uses it, how you get paid, what must never break.

You get a one-page plan and a fixed price within 24 hours.

設計 Days 1–3

The sketch

Wireframes first, then the real design in your colours. You click through it on your own phone before a single line of production code exists.

You get a clickable design, with one round of changes included.

制作 Days 3–10

The build

The heavy lifting. Clean code, fast pages, and the payments, bots and admin wired in. A private preview link updates as the work lands.

You get daily progress you can open on any device.

試験 The checkup

Every page, examined

Tested on cheap phones, slow 4G and three browsers. Forms, payments and emails are tried end to end, with real money set to zero.

You get a checklist with every test ticked.

公開 Launch day

The lantern goes up

Domain, hosting, HTTPS, Search Console and analytics set up. The switch happens at a quiet hour, and the old site is kept as a backup.

You get your site live, plus a short video on running it.

見守り After launch

Looked after

Bugs found in the first 30 days are fixed free. After that, light monthly care keeps everything updated, backed up and quick.

You get 30 days of free fixes and weekly backups.
